mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.5% relative to its 12-month average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering immediate equity sell-offs due to expected earnings contraction within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of triggered instances, or the trigger correlation coefficient drops below 0.15.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as spending slowdowns pressure earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 35% of interaction events, or the interaction term's t-statistic < 1.96.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) during supply chain disruptions forces corporate earnings revisions downward, generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 45% of INDPRO < 100 instances, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth acceleration (GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days through sustained corporate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 55% of GDPC1 growth acceleration events, or 5-year rolling Rank IC < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% with monthly acceleration > 0.5pp signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive Fed tightening that depresses equity valuations for 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of triggered events, or the trigger's predictive power (Rank IC) < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent slowing employment growth (PAYEMS < 100k) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicate labor market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days via consumer spending fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 30% of interaction events, or the interaction term's p-value > 0.1.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1000 thousand units (HOUST < 1000) during housing market downturns signals reduced consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through weakened retail spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 40% of HOUST < 1000 instances, or regime-specific Rank IC < 0.03.
